meta.name: Rappi — Mustache UX System — Design Tokens
meta.scope: Semantic colors resolved for the 'User App' product theme (light + dark). Primitives are theme-agnostic (full set). Other semantic groups (spacing, radius, stroke, opacity, typography, glass) are theme-agnostic.
meta.howToRead: Primitives are the raw values. Semantic tokens are what designers/devs actually use; each semantic color shows its resolved hex AND which primitive it points to. Always reference semantic tokens (e.g. ink/standard, background/weak), not raw primitive hex.
notes: Colors marked as primitive 'NA' (#FFFFFF00) are transparent placeholders not yet defined in the DS (e.g. interactive hover/pressed states).

The semantics file has 13 product themes (User App, RT App, Nitro, Consumer CMS, Aliados, Portal Partners, Brands, Mi Tienda, Nexus, Marketing Suite, Merchants, Cargo, Pay). Only 'User App' is included here.
Dark-mode 'primitive' is inferred by matching the resolved hex back to a primitive; a null primitive means an alpha/composite value with no direct primitive.
